newsitem.title: USA: DT Industries sees 1998 sales of $500 mln.
newsitem.headline: DT Industries sees 1998 sales of $500 mln.

text.p: DT Industries Inc expects annual revenues to be in excess of $500 million for fiscal year 1998 and plans to focus on improving margins during the period, the company said Thursday.

DT Industries, a designer and maker of automated production systems, said earlier that earnings rose 72 percent to a record $8.3 million, or $0.70 a share, during the fourth quarter. Sales rose 53.8 percent to a record $109.4 million.
For the full year ended June 29, the company's earnings before an extraordinary loss related to debt refinancing rose 95.5 percent to $26.4 million, or $2.42 per share.
Net sales for the year rose 67.9 percent to $396.1 million. Excluding acquisitions, sales increased $20.9 million or 8.8 percent.

"Over the past couple of years DT Industries has increased its revenue by nearly 170 percent -- through internal growth as well as acquisitions -- and is now on a run rate for annual revenues in excess of $500 million," Stephen Gore, president and chief executive, said in a statement.

"During fiscal 1998 we expect to focus on continued implementation of project management systems to improve margins in our Special Machines Segment, particularly at the recently acquired Lucas facilities whose operating margins are significantly less than Company averages. We also will continue to develop our operating structure to facilitate management of the growing DT Industries family.
